requests.reply:
Seoyoon, are you still at the office?
Yeah, unfortunately, the meeting hasn't ended yet. Jiu, have you already left?
I just got out. But did you manage to finalize the contract?

Yeah, I got the stamp yesterday. Now it's really over.
Wow, only three days left.
Yeah, it's a lot.

Did you hire a moving company?
No, just a partial move. I'll have to pack everything myself, and the move is on Saturday.
What about the cat? It's going to be chaos on moving day.

On Saturday, I'll drop off Barley at the pet hotel. I wrote "Barley" on the reservation form because they asked for the pet's name in English.
ㅋㅋㅋ I'm always confused whether Barley is a male or a female.
It's a female. She's three years old, but she's still shy.

Once the move is over, let's relax on Sunday. I also want to see Bobby. How about brunch?
Sounds good! Hyejin will be coming over on Sunday to help with the cleanup.
Great. So Bobby will be home that day too?

Yeah, my older brother will take me on Sunday morning.
That's good. Will Subin also come?
I asked, but Subin won't be able to come on Sunday because of a prior engagement.

That's too bad. Oh, what's the correct English spelling for Chaeyul's name? I need to send out the calendar invitation.
I'll use "Chaeyul." Not "Chaeyool."
Okay. What about the sofa? Bora used to sleep on it all the time.

I posted it on Carrot, and I got a response right away. We decided to meet tomorrow evening for a direct transaction.
Wow, that's fast. Seoyoon, you really loved that couch, didn't you?
I know, it's a shame. But since my new apartment is small, I don't have any choice.

Did you get the deposit for the old house? The landlord was pretty strict.
Yeah, I still need to clean thoroughly before Sunday.
Wow, Sunday is a day off. Should I ask Cha-eul to do it?

Yeah, they said that after the inspection, the deposit will be immediately transferred.
My older brother used to work at a moving company. Should I ask him for advice?
Oh really? Are you still working there?

No, I quit last year and now I run a cafe. But I'll still give you some tips.
Thanks! Jiu, did you also send the invitation to Cha Yul for the Monday meeting?
Yes, I just did. By the way, is it okay if Borin rides the bus?
He runs away at the sight of moving boxes. We need to lure him with snacks.
